issues.issue: Did the officer reasonably assess the best interests of the child?
issues.applicant_position: Officer misapprehended that the son spent most of his life in Canada, did not identify his best interests, and judged them only by hardship.
issues.respondent_position: A disagreement with weight; noting the child spent most of his life in Canada was not a fatal flaw.
issues.result_quote: the assessment of the best interests of the Applicants’ son was unreasonable

issues.issue: Did the officer reasonably assess the applicants' establishment and hardship?
issues.applicant_position: Officer misstated their stay, required exceptional establishment, and wrongly weighed it negatively.
issues.respondent_position: Applicants controlled their stay beyond 2014, so negative weight was open; establishment alone is not enough.
issues.result_quote: the Officer unreasonably discounted the degree to which the Applicants had established themselves in Canada
